0.name: Nuclear plant
0.description: Every nuclear plant in service (powerplantmatching): Almaraz, Ascó, Cofrentes, Vandellós and Trillo. The value is the plant's capacity; closed ones (Garoña, Zorita, Vandellós I) are not shown.

1.name: Hydroelectric plant
1.description: Hydro plants (reservoir or run-of-river) of 200 MW or more. Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

2.name: Coal plant
2.description: Coal plants of 500 MW or more that powerplantmatching does not yet list as closed. Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

3.name: Gas plant
3.description: Gas plants (mostly combined cycle) of 750 MW or more. Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

4.name: Oil plant
4.description: Fuel oil and diesel plants of 150 MW or more: the island power systems (the Canary Islands, from OpenStreetMap; the Balearic Islands, Ceuta and Melilla). Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

5.name: Pumped storage
5.description: Pumped-storage plants of 400 MW or more: grid batteries made of two reservoirs. Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

6.name: Wind farms
6.description: Wind capacity, where a hex adds up to 150 MW or more. Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

7.name: Solar plants
7.description: Solar capacity (photovoltaic and solar thermal), where a hex adds up to 150 MW or more (rooftop self-consumption not included). Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

8.name: Batteries
8.description: Battery storage, where a hex adds up to 50 MW or more. Plants of this type in one hex are added up and shown as one site.

9.name: Copper mine
9.description: Every copper working active in 2019 according to the Estadística Minera de España (IGME, Panorama Minero 2022), the latest list that names each mine. No size threshold and no value: the statistic publishes no output per mine. Each one sits at the IGME BDMIN deposit of its mineral and municipality that shares its name (or at the only large or medium one); if there is none, at the centre of its municipality, and its detail says so.
